biggest_catch: Two strict filters cut most people out: you must live in Maine, New Hampshire, or Vermont, and you must not have held a Bar Harbor Bank & Trust consumer checking account within the last 15 months — plus the $500 'direct deposit' must come from an employer, corporation, or government agency, never PayPal, teller, or ATM deposits.
catches: Open a new Relationship Rewards Checking account by 10/31/26 and enter offer code C40926A02ONLINE when opening online (or bring a downloaded coupon to a branch).
Receive at least one direct deposit of $500 or more by 12/31/26.
$400 bonus credited on or about 1/15/27; the account must be open and in good standing on that date.
$25 minimum to open. $15 monthly service charge waived only with a combined minimum daily balance of $7,500+ across personal checking, savings, and money market accounts.

Eligible direct deposits: employer, corporations, federal/state government agencies, or retirement benefits administrator. PayPal/online-banking transfers from individuals and teller/ATM deposits do NOT count.
Cannot be combined with any other offers; cannot be transferred; one offer per household; customers may participate in an account-opening promotion only once.
Employees of Bar Harbor Bank & Trust are not eligible.
The bonus is considered interest and reported to the IRS on form 1099-MISC.
